AAA
Description
AAA (authentication and accounting) module is used to authenticate the
user and/or sending user usage information to the server. It functions
as the client of the authentication IVS or accounting IVS, passing the
required parameters like username, password, usage information, etc.
IVS in turns passes these to the RADIUS authentication and accounting
hudfilter.
Commands
AAA::acct_result
- used to
check whether the accounting information is sent successfully to
IVS or not
AAA::acct_send
- used to send
user accouting information to IVS virtual
AAA::auth_result
- used to
check whether the authentication information is sent successfully
to IVS or not
AAA::auth_send
- used to send
user authentication information to IVS virtual
